'''Neuro-Saav Technologies''' was a subsidiary of the large [[Neuro-Saav Corporation]]. A producer of electronics and technological equipment, the company had divisions dedicated to manufacturing imaging systems, [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], communications equipment, military encryption and medical biotechnology. Neuro-Saav Technologies was also one of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] major [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] manufacturers.<ref name="EGWT" /> 

The company specialized in the production of weapons modifications including [[Light amplification goggles|light amplifiers]], [[holograph]]ic imaging systems, [[heat baffler]]s, and the [[VXI-3 electrotelescope]].
